page_1.body_text: Use the Enterprise Wiki to create a single, go-to place for knowledge sharing and project management across the enterprise. Enterprise Wikis are simple to use, flexible, and lightweight in features. They are quick and easy to create, and you can easily add links to other information systems, corporate directories, or applications. By using an Enterprise Wiki, you can avoid email overload, provide structure to new and existing information, and encourage collaboration. This helps build consensus among team members. Working with content - text, graphics or video - is as easy as working in any word processing application, such as Microsoft Word. Use the Rich Text Editor to enhance the formatting of content, apply styles to text, reorganize or spell check your content, insert and format tables, and embed graphics or video. You can do all these things without leaving the wiki page. Other things you can do when working with Enterprise Wikis: Collaborate on wiki pages with other users Comment on a wiki page to enable discussion about the contents of the page Rate a wiki page to share your opinion about its content Categorize wiki pages to enable users to quickly find information and share it with others

page_4.body_text: ​FAQ 1.  Copyright Restrictions 2.  How CRIKIT got it's name 3. Taxonomy 1.  Copyright Restrictions To comply with copyright restrictions, the following policies apply on CRIKIT: For Crikit Materials Any materials found on Crikit cannot be included verbatim into any work product. For Academic Literature In general all Academic papers should be added to the Academic Literature section of CRIKIT in the appropriate JEL category using the Academic Paper Template Please provide the link to the source - JSTOR, EBSCO (both available via Library Page on the Portal), SSRN, etc. Once the paper has been added under Academic Literature, you may link to that page from anywhere else in CRIKIT (for example, cite to it (see example)). In the rare instances where you feel the need to upload the paper directly to CRIKIT, please contact the IR  regarding the copyright policies for the paper in question. Please do not upload the paper unless you received an explicit permission from the IR. For Court Opinions If the Court opinion is obtained from the Court's website, you may upload it to CRIKIT directly.  Please provide the link the source (court's page) as appropriate. We cannot upload anything downloaded from Lexis or Westlaw. For Government Reports Please provide a link to the source directly (i.e. FCC page with the report in question) instead of uploading the report to CRIKIT. For additional information about Copyright, go here . 2.  How CRIKIT got it's name Background note: "wiki" in "Wikipedia" comes from "wiki wiki" which means "quick" in Hawaiian. An e-mail solicitation of possible names for Cornerstone Research (CR) knowledge management and sharing system among analysts and associates produced a list of suggestions.  A shortlist was offered to the members of Knowledge Sharing Task Force and by popular vote the name Crikit was chosen. "CRIKIT" comes from CR+WIKI+IT as in "Find it!" (and make it snappy - "wiki"). It is pronounced like "cricket." Thanks to Matt Lambert (formerly CRSF) for suggesting the winning entry. 3. 1.  Copyright Restrictions
To comply with copyright restrictions, the following policies apply on CRIKIT:
For Crikit Materials
Any materials found on Crikit cannot be included verbatim into any work product.
For Academic Literature
In general all Academic papers should be added to the Academic Literature section of CRIKIT in the appropriate JEL category using the Academic Paper Template
Please provide the link to the source - JSTOR, EBSCO (both available via Library Page on the Portal), SSRN, etc.
Once the paper has been added under Academic Literature, you may link to that page from anywhere else in CRIKIT (for example, cite to it (see example)).
In the rare instances where you feel the need to upload the paper directly to CRIKIT, please contact the IR  regarding the copyright policies for the paper in question.
Please do not upload the paper unless you received an explicit permission from the IR.
For Court Opinions

If the Court opinion is obtained from the Court's website, you may upload it to CRIKIT directly.  Please provide the link the source (court's page) as appropriate. We cannot upload anything downloaded from Lexis or Westlaw.
For Government Reports
Please provide a link to the source directly (i.e. FCC page with the report in question) instead of uploading the report to CRIKIT.
For additional information about Copyright, gohere.
2.  How CRIKIT got it's name
Background note: "wiki" in "Wikipedia" comes from "wiki wiki" which means "quick" in Hawaiian.

An e-mail solicitation of possible names for Cornerstone Research (CR) knowledge management and sharing system among analysts and associates produced a list of suggestions.  A shortlist was offered to the members of Knowledge Sharing Task Force and by popular vote the name Crikit was chosen.
"CRIKIT" comes fromCR+WIKI+ITas in "Find it!" (and make it snappy - "wiki").
It is pronounced like "cricket."
Thanks to Matt Lambert (formerly CRSF) for suggesting the winning entry.

page_11.body_text: Courtroom View Network (CVN) Source Courtroom View Network (CVN) How to Cite the Source Courtroom View Network Description Courtroom View Network (CVN) delivers live and on-demand video and editorial coverage of high-stakes civil litigation. Since 2004, the CVN video library has grown to include over 1,000 trials with tens of thousands of hours of fully indexed, searchable video. Unless otherwise stated, all trials are fully indexed with evidence slides so that you see exactly what was presented at trial. Users can search by trial name, attorney, judge, expert witness, and more. Premium CVN docket, gavel-to-gavel CVN Video, and CVN Training services are provided as subscriptions, which provide access to trials, hearings, oral arguments, and other courtroom video that may be streamed over the Internet. Users may watch proceedings Live, or On Demand, on their personal computer, depending on the subscription. Video may also be viewed on DVD-ROM (Computer Only, playable in the CVN Player with synched digital exhibits) or DVD. When ordering DVDs, subscribers select proceedings at on CVN.com and receive them on DVD by U.S. mail or Fedex. CVN Video proceedings are designated into two categories: CVN Live Current Cases and CVN On Demand Archive Cases. CVN Live Current Cases are proceedings that are upcoming, in progress, or concluded within the last 30 days. These proceedings are available in one or all of the following formats: Live, On Demand, on DVD. A CVN Live subscription provides video access to all Current Cases, with premium events available only under a CVN Live Premium subscription. CVN On Demand Archive Cases are proceedings that concluded more than 30 days ago, and where the video has undergone a quality assessment, quality improvement where possible, and video chapters are logged for better browsing and navigation. These proceedings are available in these formats: DVD, On Demand. These proceedings are sold in a discount subscription and available through an annual CVN On Demand subscription. CVN's Editorial team finds trials using a variety of sources, including dockets and news articles. They also receive many tips and they poll subscribers to find out what they want to see. List of cases covered Time Period Covered 2004 - present Access Must purchase subscription Contact: #Information Resources Cost Video Library access online: https://cvn.com/pricing ($99 per month for 1 person, $399 per month for up to 6). This only includes online viewing of completed trials. Premium Live Access or Digital Downloads: Pricing for live and on-demand access to a single case is below. Each account or user would be able to log in from one device at a time. 1-3 accounts - $600 per day 4-6 accounts - $800 per day 7-9 accounts - $1000 per day Firm Wide - $1200 per day Downloadable files in addition to any option above would be $400 per day. Downloadable files would be delivered within 36 hours of each day ending. Live and on-demand access for the firm to all trials we cover would be $3,000 per month on an annual contract. Important Notes CVN focuses on civil litigation. Memberships automatically renew unless cancelled, which can be done on the Account page. Video Library memberships do not include access to live trials. CVN will periodically offer certain live trials to our members depending on interest. We would need to negotiate a license with CVN if we were to get a full subscription. AI Restrictions Parent company Remote Counsel (RC) grants users a limited license to access and make personal use of CVN and not to download (other than page caching) or modify it, or any portion of it, except with express written consent of RC. This license does not include any resale or commercial use of CVN.com or its contents; any collection and use of any product listings, descriptions, or prices; any derivative use of CVN.com or its contents; any downloading or copying of account information for the benefit of another merchant; or any use of data mining, robots, or similar data gathering and extraction tools. CVN.com and any portion of it content may not be reproduced, duplicated, copied, sold, resold, visited, or otherwise exploited for any commercial purpose without express written consent of RC. AI Definitions/Capabilities ​ Updated 9/25/25_hg
